outcome: Change in residual isthmocele nidus size
finding: Vaginal surgery was more effective than operative hysteroscopy in treating cesarean-induced isthmocele, resulting in greater improvement in menstrual periods and residual isthmocele nidus size, but was associated with longer operating times and greater blood loss.
mod_finding: This study found that vaginal surgery was more efficacious than operative hysteroscopy for treating cesarean-induced isthmocele.
